description: Initiate a $0.01 USDC onboarding handshake for a new DPX integration. Returns the DPX treasury address and payment instructions. The client sends $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet to confirm their wallet is funded and settlement rails are clear. Call integration.status to poll for confirmation. Required for all new integrations before production settlements are enabled.

apiKey.description: Optional: the DPX API key being registered for this integration. Stored as a hash — never logged in plaintext.

walletAddress.description: The client wallet address (0x...) that will send the $0.01 verification payment.

name: integration.verify
